title: In the Woods
author: Tana French
summary: A Dublin detective who as a boy was the only child to survive a mysterious disappearance in the woods is assigned a new case. A young girl has been found dead at the same woodland site.
readIf: you like slow, atmospheric crime novels with beautiful writing and a flawed narrator.
skipIf: you want every question answered, because the book leaves a major thread deliberately unresolved.

pairings.reason: Another beautifully written story about a close group, a death and a narrator who is not telling everything.
A more traditional, easier detective story that uses a similar investigator pair.
